title: Length after pairing
statement: For any Boolean gate type $b$ and any finite list $cs$ of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables, the list obtained by grouping consecutive circuits into pairs (leaving a final unpaired circuit, if present) has length $\lceil |cs|/2\rceil$, equivalently $(|cs|+1)/2$ with integer division.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list $cs$ of circuit trees on $n$ variables
